d:
Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shahi shadi ki charcha desh hi nahin, videshon tak pahunch gaee. BBC, The Guardian aur Daily Mail jaisi videshi midiya ne shadi ke bhavy intjam, lakhon mehmanon aur rajnitik rasukh par kya likha? bihar ke sabse charchit veding samaroh ko videshi midiya ne kis najrie se dekha, janie is riport men.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
